feature: Laporan ad-hoc HST: Alternative Address Furnished dan Hirer/Driver Furnished (GET /v1/hst/reports/alternative-address dan /hirer-driver-furnished)
story: Tidak jelas (kemungkinan sibling OCMS20.27/20.20, belum dicek); bukan OCMS20.21-20.25
note: Endpoint staff API yang menggabungkan ocms_furnish_application dengan ocms_hst untuk menampilkan alamat furnish_mail di samping alamat HST dalam rentang tanggal. Sumbernya aplikasi furnish, bukan appeal PLUS, sehingga tidak memenuhi OCMS20.23/20.24. Tidak ada pemanggil di ocmsadminui (grep alternative-address dan hst/reports kosong) dan tidak ada mapping di api-authorization.properties, jadi siapa yang memakainya cannot verify from repo.
note_en: Staff API endpoints that join ocms_furnish_application with ocms_hst to show the furnish_mail address next to the HST address within a date range. The source is furnish applications, not PLUS appeals, so it does not satisfy OCMS20.23/20.24. There is no caller in ocmsadminui (grep for alternative-address and hst/reports is empty) and no mapping in api-authorization.properties, so who uses it cannot verify from repo.
